paper_title: Direct Searches for Hidden-Photon Dark Matter with the SHUKET Experiment
notes: SHUKET dish-antenna hidden photon search (arXiv:1905.05579). Wide-band scan 5-6.8 GHz (20.8-28.3 ueV) yields chi < ~5e-12 at 95% CL (stated in text as approximately flat over the mass range; actual limit in Fig. 4/5 varies with frequency but no table is provided, so a flat two-point bound is emitted). A narrow-band 22.2 h run at 6.331525 GHz (m = 2.62e-5 eV) gives an upper limit on signal power of 2.1e-21 W vs ~1e-18 W average; the corresponding chi ~ 2.3e-13 is derived by sqrt(P) scaling from the quoted 5e-12 wide-band value. Assumes HP constitutes all local DM with rho = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 3))
